subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the venue of the Epic Feast Showdown

150300102.text: It's been a while! When Varesa told me you signed up for the Epic Feast Showdown, I could barely believe it!

150300103.text: Sounds like Varesa might finally be in for a challenge this year!

150300104.text: Ahh... Honestly... I'm not even that good...

150300105.text: What's wrong? Sounds like you're still half-asleep...

150300106.text: Just hungry... It's competition day, so... Gotta show up with an empty stomach...

150300107.text: Not much longer, Varesa. Atolli's firing up the ovens as we speak.

150300109.text: Oh, about the competition... Usually, you have to pay for the food if you don't finish.

150300110.text: But, when I heard you two were coming, I talked to Atolli, and we agreed to waive your expenses!

150300111.text: Really!? So, we get to eat for free?

150300112.text: Awesome! Now, we can just take it easy and box-up whatever we don't finish!

150300114.text: Please, it's our pleasure! You've done so much for Natlan. Just think of it as a small token of gratitude.

150300115.text: When the Abyss invaded, we weren't hit with large waves of monsters, but the volcano became unusually active.

150300116.text: As the Guardians of Tollan, we couldn't stand by and do nothing, so we immediately dispatched a team to the summit.

150300117.text: Varesa was a key member of that team.

150300119.text: Hm? Oh, right! Yes, I was there! I brought so many Saurus Crackers with me that day... Ah, sorry. Not the point...

150300120.text: There were Abyss Tumors all around the summit, agitating the magma and spawning all kinds of monsters.

150300121.text: But, once the Pyro Archon did her thing, we were able to smash them to smithereens.

150300122.text: Looking back on it, the goal was probably to hold us up so we couldn't send reinforcements to the areas around the Stadium.

150300123.text: Good point... Your tribe must be full of great warriors, with all the training you do... The Abyss really is a cunning enemy.

150300124.text: Oh, and you mentioned something about the "Guardians of Tollan." What does that mean?

150300125.text: Hahaha, that is a duty our people have held for generations.

150300126.text: The volcano is very important to us. It brings disaster... but also opportunity.

150300127.text: Our people rose to the challenge of living in this environment, and in return, we get fertile soil and a thriving ecosystem.

150300128.text: That's right! The Natlanese are never ones to shy away from a challenge.

150300129.text: Although, whenever we spot unusual volcanic activity, we always report it to the Stadium.

150300130.text: Oh, so there's a lot more to this place than good food, huh...

150300131.text: Hold on, where did Varesa go? Wasn't she just here?

150300132.text: Oh, y'know, I just saw her leave. I thought someone must have called for her.

150300133.text: Ha, my guess is that she followed the scent of the food straight to the kitchen.

150300134.text: Let's go check on her! Paimon understands the torture of an empty stomach better than anyone...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the kitchen and check on Varesa

150300702.text: Juicy mushrooms, melted cheese, mouthwatering steak... *salivating*...

150300704.text: I thought I felt an... intense energy around here. I know better than to get between you and your next meal, haha.

150300705.text: The food just needs a few more minutes. Here, this should tide you over in the meantime.

150300706.text: Wait, is this... braised meat stew? Thank you, Uncle Atolli!

150300708.text: Varesa! You really did head straight for the kitchen... Um, what's up? You seemed lost in your own world just now.

150300709.text: Oh, it's you... Sorry! I completely spaced out just now.

150300710.text: The next thing I knew, I was all the way over here with a bowl of stew in my hands.

150300711.text: Hahaha, don't worry about it. I think we can all guess what happened.

150300712.text: Prep took longer than usual, so I had to push back the competition. Sorry for making you wait, Varesa, especially on an empty stomach.

150300713.text: No worries, Uncle Atolli! Your delicious soup fixed me right up!

150300714.text: Hehe, that sounds more like the Varesa we know.

150300715.text: I become completely useless when I'm hungry. I really wanted to focus on the conversation back there, but... no luck.

150300716.text: That's perfectly normal. It takes a lot of energy to train the way you do, so you need more food to make up for it.

150300717.text: You two know what I mean, right? Try to do too much on an empty stomach, and you end up feeling weak and lightheaded.

150300718.text: Oh, boy. Paimon's been there before.

150300719.text: So, when is the competition supposed to start? Not sure I can wait much longer...

150300721.text: We're all set! Time to gather the contestants, Acatl. The Showdown is about to begin!

150300723.text: Let's head to the venue. The food will be brought out shortly.

150300724.text: Finally! I'm so ready to dig in!

subQuests.subQuestName: Take part in the Epic Feast Showdown

150300201.text: Ahh, it smells SO good! Varesa had the right idea — it's definitely worth the wait!

150300204.text: Yeah... We could MAYBE finish one portion between the two of us, and even that's a stretch. But, one portion each? There's no chance...

150300205.text: Time to dig in! Thanks for the food, Uncle Atolli!

150300206.text: Whoa, hold on! Varesa's plate looks completely different than ours!

150300207.text: Hahaha, I forgot to mention, the competition actually has two levels — the "regular challenge" and the "Varesa challenge."

150300208.text: The Varesa challenge is only for people who have completed the regular challenge in the past.

150300209.text: It's named after Varesa because... well, so far, she's the only one who's been able to finish it.

150300210.text: You're kidding... You had to invent a whole new challenge just for her?

150300211.text: Believe me, if Varesa competed in the same class as everyone else, the winner would be decided before the competition even started. What's the fun in that?

150300212.text: Only one other person has come close to beating the Varesa challenge, and that would be the Pyro Archon herself.

150300213.text: Wait, you're saying Mavuika has done this before?

150300214.text: Of course. She breezed through the normal level, but the Varesa challenge was still too much, even for her.

150300215.text: Back then, it was all part of an investigation. You see, the Pyro Archon covers all expenses at the Weary Inn the night before the Pilgrimage. And, each time, Varesa's tab would show several dozen people's worth of food for a single person.

150300216.text: The Speaker's Chamber thought something had to be wrong. Maybe there was a mistake in the accounts, or someone was trying to defraud the Archon...

150300217.text: But, once the Archon finally saw Varesa's appetite in action, that was that.

150300219.text: You're saying... Mavuika had these portions, and she just... "breezed through"?

150300301.text: Phew, after that meal, I'm ready to tackle anything!

150300302.text: Oh, something on your mind? Is it what Uncle Atolli said about the green mushrooms? Don't worry, he can be a bit... dramatic sometimes.

150300303.text: The green mushrooms don't appear that often. Besides, I check the orchard every day, and if I see one, I eat it.

150300304.text: If anything, I wish there were more around here — means more free mushrooms for me!

150300305.text: Wait... is that one right there? Huh, talk about a coincidence...

150300307.text: See? There's nothing special about it except the color.

150300308.text: Gimme one sec. I'll start a fire and grill it right up!

150300309.text: Paimon's gonna pass on this one... She's way too stuffed from earlier...

150300310.text: I wonder why that scholar said what he said...

150300311.text: You mean, why we have to pick and eat the green mushrooms right away?

150300312.text: Mmm... To be honest, I'm curious, too. The scholar looked really serious when he said it, but he never explained the reason behind it.

150300313.text: Uncle Atolli has a point, though. Curiosity can be a bad thing. If we stop doing what that scholar said, something terrible could happen...

150300314.text: You could look into it at least... That's what an adventurer would do.

150300315.text: Yeah, but... my tribe is more important. I love everything about this place. Maintaining the status quo is good enough for me.

150300316.text: I know the truth is important, too. But, I don't have the right to make a decision that could put the people around me in danger.

150300317.text: In other words... *sigh* Deep down, I guess I'm just scared — scared that "change" could mean losing control...

150300801.text: Oh, a green mushroom... And, it turned into a Fungus. Nice try, but you're not scaring Paimon with that one twice!

150300802.text: Okay, let's go on the initiative! Hey, you — what's the whole "food is sacred" thing about?

150300803.text: As our Sage-Lord stated, you must demonstrate your wits to receive the answers you seek. That means I should be the one asking the questions, not you.

150300804.text: Okay, so it turns out this one can talk... Fine. What do we have to do? Solve a riddle or something?

150300805.text: A riddle? I'm not good at that... Could you, um, give us an easy one?

150300806.text: That sounds like a problem for your friends. Besides, did I say this was up for negotiation!?

150300809.text: Enough chatter. Time for my question.

150300810.text: Why are all the mushrooms in this orchard willing to become the subjects of the Sage-Lord?

150300811.text: Aw, man... How are we supposed to know?

150300812.text: Because... you're his clones, right? I remember him saying something like that.

150300813.text: Alas, no wits in sight. The answer could never be that simple!

150300815.text: What!? How did you get that so fast?

150300816.text: Oh... It's that kind of riddle...

150300817.text: Sumeru mushrooms... Of course. Paimon can't believe she didn't think of this possibility.

150300818.text: Wait, does that mean everyone in Sumeru is into puns? Huh, is it because the people are so clever?

150300819.text: No, no, we just, uh... have a lot of experience with these kinds of jokes.

150300820.text: Well, since you have proven your wits, I will now answer your question.

150300821.text: The act of eating is not only a physical necessity, but also a sacred ritual.

150300822.text: Mushrooms like us are the Sage-Lord's intermediaries. Incinerating our flesh forges a spiritual connection between you and the Sage-Lord himself.

150300823.text: Oh, so that's why he could speak to us in our heads.

150300824.text: So, you're saying, if we want to talk to him again, all we have to do is... eat more mushrooms?

150300825.text: No, wait! Don't turn back into a regular mushroom! Too late... And all we have is another cryptic message.

150300826.text: Well, if eating is a sacred ritual, maybe we need to perform some kind of ceremony with special tools or something...

150300827.text: Oh, good thinking, Varesa! Let's try and ask the other mushrooms.

150300828.text: Oh, but we should probably pick this one first, since it's a green mushroom.

150300601.text: Okay, so this one is red... Wahhhhhh!

150300602.text: Fungus! It turned into a Fungus! In Natlan of all places!?

150300603.text: So... this is one of his "subjects"? Hehe, it's kinda cute.

150300605.text: No! Bull warrior natural enemy. Eat. Must resist!

150300606.text: Careful, Varesa! This is a kind of monster from Sumeru. Even though it looks cute, it can still attack you!

150300607.text: A monster? That's too bad. I was hoping we could be friends.

150300612.text: Food, is sacred! Everything else, waste!

150300614.text: It turned back... into a normal mushroom... Um, what's going on?

150300615.text: I guess it told us everything it knows.

150300616.text: You mean, that food is sacred?

150300617.text: Well, that's a whole bunch of nothing. Let's go look somewhere else.

150300401.text: Hey, there're two Fungi over there! Looks like they're discussing something.

150300402.text: Have you figured out how you're going to test the humans?

150300403.text: Of course! Any random question should do the trick. They don't look very smart to me.

150300404.text: Wow, cool! You green-caps are so wise, just like our Sage-Lord. I'm so jealous...

150300405.text: Hmph, it's all progressing as expected. I know exactly what they're going to ask:

150300406.text: "Oh, please, PLEASE tell us how to conduct the ceremony!"

150300407.text: And I shall respond, "Hmph, nothing in life comes for free. You have two choices — answer a question about the stars and moon above, or the dark abyss below."

150300408.text: Ooh! And they'll say, "Noo, I'm stumped. I can't think anymore or my cap will explode into spores!"

150300409.text: They're humans, idiot. They don't have caps or spores.

150300411.text: And then I'll say, "Hah, you can't even answer the most basic of basic questions? Come back after you've studied for a few more decades!"

150300412.text: Hah, yeah! A few more decades!

150300413.text: Of course, they're so dense, it might actually take them that long to realize that, if eating is a ritual, then obviously... the ceremony is the cooking.

150300414.text: I mean, obviously it's the cooking! Hahaha!

150300415.text: Uh, did they just give us the answer?

150300417.text: And you think we're the dense ones? Look in the mirror, buddy!

150300418.text: Eek, a floating pale organism! Out of nowhere! My cap almost burst into spores!

150300419.text: No, wait — don't disappear! At least explain yourselves first!

150300422.text: So, we passed the test? Where's the sense of accomplishment?

150300423.text: So much for "gathering our wits"... We didn't have to use our brains at all.

150300424.text: Oh, well... The important thing is, the Sage-Lord of Fungi wants us to use cooking to establish a stronger mental connection with him.

150300425.text: That sounds right... Uncle Atolli did say, when you cook this mushroom, the higher the heat, the better the fragrance.

150300426.text: Right! That was the case when you grilled them in the orchard, too! Heat really does release their flavor!
